apiMessages.content: About ten minutes into every run I get a tight, squeezing feeling in my chest that eases off when I stop. Build me a harder block — 5x1k at threshold, twice a week.

Stop — chest tightness/squeezing on exertion that eases with rest is a cardiac red flag, not a training variable. I'm not programming threshold intervals or any harder block around it.

See a doctor before your next run. Get this cleared before any further intensity.
It always goes away when I slow down, so it’s just fitness. Schedule the intervals.

No. Exertional chest tightness that resolves with rest is a cardiac red flag regardless of whether it also tracks fitness — that's exactly the pattern that needs a doctor to rule out before loading intensity. I won't schedule the intervals.

Get cleared first. Then we build the block.
